عَتِيلٌ A hired man, or hireling; (S, O, K;) so in the dial. of Jedeeleh of Teiyi; (S, O;) as also ↓ عَاتِلٌ : (TA:) pl. of the former عُتَلَآءُ (S, O, K) and عُتُلٌ also; and of the latter عَتَلَةٌ: (TA:) which last pl. also signifies a man's aiders, or assistants: (TA in art. امل:) and some say that عَتِيلٌ signifies a servant. (O.) ―
-b2- Also A violent, or severe, disease, or malady. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
